name: agent-brain
description: Retrieve and preserve private knowledge and coordinate tracked tasks with a native brain through MCP.

interface.longDescription: Retrieve context about people, companies, projects and decisions from your private a native brain. Save authorized updates with sources and version checks, and create, claim and complete tracked Brain tasks. Requires an authenticated Brain MCP connection.
defaultPrompt: Use Agent Brain to recover the context and decisions for this project.
Use Agent Brain to list my open tasks for this project.
